Question Choices: Find the smallest positive integer x such that 7x ≡ 1 (mod 17).
Hints: Try 7×1, 7×2, ... until you get 1 more than a multiple of 17

Question Choices: Find all moduli n such that 5 and 6 are inverses (mod n).
Hints: 5 × 6 - 1 must be a multiple of n;n must be larger than 6
Solution: 5 × 6 = 30, so n must divide 29 and n > 6. Since 29 is prime, n = 29.

Question Choices: Find the inverse of 3 (mod 51), or say that it does not exist.
Hints: An inverse exists only when the number and the modulus are coprime
Solution: Does not exist: 51 = 3 × 17, so 3 and 51 are not coprime and 3 has no inverse mod 51.
